name: speech-translation-systems
description: A systematic literature review examining speech translation systems, focusing on real-time translation platforms, technologies, approaches, and evaluation metrics in multilingual communication.
research_questions: What are the main approaches and architectures used in speech translation systems?
What are the key performance metrics and evaluation frameworks for speech translation systems?
How do contemporary speech translation systems handle real-time processing and latency constraints?
What are the current challenges and limitations in speech translation quality and coverage?
What languages and language pairs are currently supported by state-of-the-art systems?
